prompt: Style & Mood: Clean interface-native tech realism on an off-white canvas (#F8F9FB), deep slate-navy geometry, emerald-green growth accents and hot-orange action highlights. Soft studio light, shallow depth of field, bold sans-serif UI type floating in 3D space. Narrative Summary: Scattered social accounts snap into one hub, a campaign generates posts that publish across every platform on schedule, analytics rise, and incoming comments get auto-replies. Dynamic Description: Slow push-in as five loose social channel icons drift in from the edges and lock into a single central navy hub, emerald connection lines snapping taut between them. Hard cut to a wide top-down stabilized shot — a glowing 'CAMPAIGN' card pulses orange and spawns three ready-made post cards that fan out. Cut to a medium tracking shot rising as the post cards fire left-to-right down parallel pipelines to platform nodes, a small clock badge stamping 'SCHEDULED' on each. Cut to a locked-off close-up of a dashboard panel: line and bar graphs climb in emerald, view and like counters ticking up. Quick cut to an incoming comment bubble sliding in — an auto-reply bubble instantly types back beneath it in orange, a check mark snapping on. Static Description: Minimal off-white 3D space, thin navy pipeline geometry, floating rounded UI cards, platform icon nodes, chat bubbles, soft grid floor, drifting light particles, the wordmark 'pipelyt' resolving lower-frame.

风格与氛围：简洁的界面原生科技写实风，米白色画布（#F8F9FB），深板岩藏青几何线条，翡翠绿代表增长的点缀与炽橙色行动高光。柔和影棚光，浅景深，粗体无衬线UI文字漂浮于三维空间。叙事概要：分散的社媒账号汇聚成一个中枢，一个营销活动生成帖子并按计划发布到每个平台，数据上升，收到的评论被自动回复。动态描述：缓慢推进，五个松散的社媒渠道图标从画面边缘飘入，锁入中央藏青枢纽，翡翠绿连接线在它们之间骤然绷紧。硬切至广角俯拍稳定镜头——一张发光的'CAMPAIGN'卡片泛起橙光，衍生出三张成品帖子卡片呈扇形展开。切至中景跟随上升镜头，帖子卡片从左向右沿并行管线射向各平台节点，每个节点被小时钟标记盖上'SCHEDULED'。切至锁定特写，仪表盘面板上折线与柱状图以翡翠绿攀升，浏览与点赞计数向上跳动。快切至一个滑入的评论气泡——其下方一个橙色自动回复气泡瞬间打字回应，一个对勾骤然亮起。静态描述：极简米白三维空间，纤细藏青管线几何，漂浮圆角UI卡片，平台图标节点，对话气泡，柔和网格地面，漂移光粒子，画面下方'pipelyt'标识渐显。
